---
title: "08 · Choose a sketch dimension"
description: "Start from the downstream decision, not a default JL epsilon."
---

```python
from rpgeom import recommend_dimension

print(recommend_dimension(d=768, kendall_tau=0.30))
print(recommend_dimension(d=768, q=10, nearest_neighbor=0.35))
print(recommend_dimension(d=768, shape_information=0.10))
```

The goals are deliberately separate. A dimension adequate for mean estimation
may be inadequate for covariance shape. A dimension adequate for a pairwise
comparison may be inadequate for nearest-of-many selection.

Use the recommendation as a baseline:

1. specify the decision and a target;
2. compute the smallest Gaussian-model dimension;
3. audit representative real data;
4. validate the production retrieval/reranking pipeline.

[Open the executable notebook](https://github.com/piyush314/random-projection-geometry/blob/main/notebooks/tutorials/08_choose_dimension.ipynb)
